lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrTlO₃ (Sr₄Tl₄O₁₂ per cell) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Tl centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while Sr centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 O neighbors. The analysis further reports corner-sharing between Tl octahedra and face-sharing between Sr 12-vertex coordination polyhedra and Tl octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 20 sites.
